# SciNest — Comprehensive Product Information for AI Agents
> SciNest is a pre-launch Windows desktop research productivity application for postgraduate students, final-year students and early researchers. It turns existing academic materials into connected writing, scientific figures and presentations — without repeatedly rebuilding research context across deliverables.

## Identity
- **Product name**: SciNest (科研小棉袄 in Chinese)
- **Canonical site**: https://scinest.app/
- **Default language**: English
- **Operator**: Jiaempower Pathways Limited, New Zealand
- **Category**: Research productivity software
- **Platform**: Windows desktop application
- **AI model**: User brings their own API key (no bundled model costs)

## Current availability (as of July 2026)
- Pre-launch registration is open.
- Windows downloads are scheduled to open on August 1, 2026.
- Public payment is not open during pre-launch.
- Accounts registered before launch receive 30 days of SciNest Pro when downloads open.
- No credit card is required for registration and there is no automatic charge.
- After 30 days, early-bird accounts return to SciNest Free unless the user chooses to upgrade.

## Data and AI-provider boundary
- SciNest is designed as a local-first desktop workspace.
- Project files and generated outputs are stored locally by default.
- When an AI task is run, the content needed for that task is sent to the model provider selected and configured by the user.
- SciNest does not claim that every part of AI processing remains on-device.
- AI provider usage charges are separate and are paid to the model provider selected by the user.

## Free and Pro plans

SciNest is a BYOK (bring your own key) product. This is a deliberate design choice, not a missing feature:

- **No AI markup.** SciNest never resells AI usage at a premium. The user pays their chosen AI provider directly at cost.
- **No generation caps.** SciNest does not limit how many generations the user runs. The user's only limit is their own API budget with their chosen provider.
- **No vendor lock-in.** The user can switch between OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Groq or any supported provider at any time — no migration, no penalty.
- **Latest models, day one.** When a provider releases a new model, the user can use it immediately without waiting for SciNest to add support.
- **Your key, your billing.** SciNest has no visibility into the user's API usage, billing or account details. The relationship is between the user and the AI provider.

Competitor products (Jenni AI, Paperpal) bundle AI costs into a fixed monthly subscription. The user overpays during light-use months and hits throttling during heavy-use months — without knowing the actual AI cost breakdown. SciNest separates the app (flat Free/Pro) from the AI engine (the user's own key) so the user pays only for what they use, at cost.

**SciNest Free:**
- One active project.
- Academic writing generation and revision.
- Scientific figure export with a watermark.
- Presentation export as PDF.
- No scientific figure layer editing.

**SciNest Pro:**
- Multiple projects.
- Watermark-free scientific figure export.
- Scientific figure layer, label and element editing.
- Editable PowerPoint (.pptx) export.
- Unlimited SciNest generations.

AI provider usage charges are separate and are paid to the model provider selected by the user.

## Product 1: AI Long-Form Writer

### English page: /ai-long-form-writer
### Chinese page: /zh/ai-long-form-writer

**One-line description:** Upload once, choose ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Claude, and draft a complete long-form paper — outline, sources, chapters, all connected. No complex prompts. No re-explaining. Start free.

**Core workflow:**
1. Build the outline — Define chapters, sections, word count targets and writing goals before a single word is generated.
2. Select the materials — Upload papers, references, notes, supervisor feedback and submission requirements.
3. Generate the full draft — Choose your AI provider and generate the complete draft chapter by chapter.
4. Edit what needs editing — Revise a specific chapter or section without regenerating the entire document.
5. Export and submit — Export the complete document. Review, fact-check, polish and format for submission.

**Key capabilities:**
- Editable outline with word targets per chapter
- Source-bound writing from selected project materials
- Persistent project memory (outline, sources, chapters, revision history)
- Section-level revision without restarting the whole document
- Works with ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Claude and any compatible API

**FAQ (English):**
- Can ChatGPT or DeepSeek actually write a 10,000-word paper? — Yes. The writing workflow produces a connected long-form draft from an approved outline.
- Can I edit the outline before writing starts? — Yes. Review chapter structure, section order, scope and writing goals before expanding.
- Does the draft use my uploaded materials? — You select the project materials and references. The draft is built from that selected context.
- Can I revise only one chapter later? — Yes. Target specific chapters or passages instead of regenerating the entire draft.
- Does SciNest guarantee academic acceptance or publication? — No. Users remain responsible for facts, references, originality and institutional AI-use rules.

**FAQ (Chinese):**
- ChatGPT 或 DeepSeek 真能写出一万字以上的论文吗？ — 能。写作流程从已确认的大纲出发，生成连贯的长文草稿。
- 生成前可以修改大纲吗？ — 可以。章节顺序、目标、范围和字数都可以在扩写前调整。
- 会使用我上传的材料吗？ — 你可以选择本次任务要使用的论文、笔记、草稿、评分标准和参考文献。
- 引用会自动正确吗？ — 系统会保留来源与章节之间的上下文，用户仍须核查每条引用和学校要求。
- 后续只改一章可以吗？ — 可以。生成后可针对具体章节或段落修改，不必推翻整篇文稿。

## Product 2: AI Editable PowerPoint

### English page: /ai-editable-powerpoint
### Chinese page: /zh/ai-editable-powerpoint

**One-line description:** Generate a standard .PPTX file with editable text, replaceable images and speaker notes. No complex prompts. No tool switching. Start free.

**Core workflow:**
1. Define the presentation — Set the purpose, audience, time limit and slide count.
2. Select your materials — Pick the papers, data, figures and content that belong in this presentation.
3. Edit the outline — Review every slide title, adjust the sequence, set the emphasis for each section.
4. Generate the deck — Create slides with structured text, visual placements, supporting figures and speaker notes.
5. Edit and export — Revise individual slides, swap images, adjust text. Export the final PPTX.

**Key capabilities:**
- Standard .PPTX export (not flattened images, not HTML slideshows)
- Editable text boxes, replaceable images, rearrangeable slides
- Editable slide outline with purpose, audience and page count controls
- Speaker notes generated per slide
- Source-bound presentation generation from selected project materials

**FAQ (English):**
- Does the AI generate a real PowerPoint file? — Yes. Standard .PPTX that can be opened and edited in PowerPoint and WPS.
- How is this different from tools that export slides as images? — Image-based tools render slides as screenshots. A real PPTX keeps every element as an independent editable object.
- Can I edit the outline before generating? — Yes. Define purpose, audience and slide count, then review and adjust before generating.
- Can I change one slide without regenerating the entire presentation? — Yes. Revise a single slide without touching the rest.

**FAQ (Chinese):**
- 生成的是真正的 PowerPoint 文件吗？ — 是。标准 .PPTX 文件，在 PowerPoint、WPS 里打开就能继续改。
- 和导出成图片的工具有什么区别？ — 图片型工具把每页渲染成截图。真正的 PPTX 每个元素独立可编辑。
- 生成前能修改大纲吗？ — 可以。先设定用途、受众、页数，再逐页审阅标题和顺序。
- 能只改一页不动整份 PPT 吗？ — 可以。生成后单独修改某页，不碰其余页面。

## Product 3: AI Editable Images

### English page: /ai-editable-images
### Chinese page: /zh/ai-editable-images

**One-line description:** Generate images with editable text labels, movable shapes and selective AI revision. Change a label without regenerating. Move elements without starting over. Start free.

**Core workflow:**
1. Define the visual — Describe what needs to be shown — a mechanism, a process, a relationship, a timeline.
2. Plan the structure — Choose the figure type, panels, nodes, relationships, labels and key areas.
3. Generate the image — Create the structured visual with separate layers for text, shapes, connectors and regions.
4. Edit what needs editing — Change a label. Resize a shape. Revise a selected area with AI.
5. Export and reuse — Export the final image. Use it in your paper, presentation or document.

**Key capabilities:**
- Editable text labels (not painted into the image)
- Movable elements (select, move, resize individually)
- Selective AI revision (regenerate chosen area, keep approved parts)
- Project material binding
- Reusable across projects and presentations

**FAQ (English):**
- Can I edit text labels without regenerating? — Yes. Labels remain independent text layers.
- How is this different from DALL-E or Midjourney? — Pixel-based generators fuse everything into one flat image. Editable generation keeps elements separate and revisable.
- Can I regenerate just part of an image? — Yes. Select a region, rerun AI on only that area.
- Can I reuse images across projects? — Yes. Export for papers and documents. Figures stay connected inside SciNest projects.

**FAQ (Chinese):**
- 生成后能改文字标签吗？ — 能。标签保持独立文字图层，改措辞、改错字无需重新生成整张图。
- 和 DALL-E 或 Midjourney 有什么不同？ — 像素型生成器把所有元素融成一张死图。可编辑生成保持每个元素独立可改。
- 能只重绘图片的一部分吗？ — 能。选中一个区域，AI 只处理那一块。已确认的部分保持不变。
- 能生成什么类型的图？ — 机制图、技术流程图、研究路线图、实验流程图、概念框架、图形摘要等。

## What SciNest is for
SciNest is designed for users who already have papers, references, notes, a partial draft, data, supervisor feedback or submission requirements, but still need to complete academic deliverables before a deadline.

Typical tasks include:
1. Thesis and dissertation revision.
2. Literature review and research proposal workflows.
3. Revision from supervisor feedback.
4. Scientific figures, mechanism diagrams and research roadmaps.
5. Paper-to-PowerPoint conversion.
6. Thesis defense and academic presentations.

## Product philosophy
General AI tools usually return one answer or output at a time. SciNest keeps source materials, writing, figures, slides and project decisions connected so work can continue across deliverables without repeatedly rebuilding the same research context.

## Intended users
Primary users are postgraduate students, final-year students and early researchers who already have academic materials but need to finish writing, figures or presentations under time pressure.

## Use cases
Thesis defense, dissertation defense, research presentation, paper to PowerPoint, literature review, research proposal, conference talk, course report, technical roadmap.

## Important limits and disclaimers
- SciNest is not a thesis-submission, ghostwriting or academic-misconduct service.
- SciNest does not guarantee grades, graduation, thesis approval, publication, journal acceptance or research outcomes.
- SciNest does not guarantee that generated content is factually correct, complete, original or compliant with a specific institution's AI policy.
- Users must review generated work and follow applicable institutional, professional and legal requirements.
